scope: Independent source review of release, two-arm executor, startup/pause/resume scripts, configuration and CPU tests. No GPU training or model/API inference performed by reviewer.

findings.description: Startup originally lacked executable review binding; validate_code_review now requires exact hashes of all eight reviewed files and freezes review evidence hash in protocol.

Initial incomplete-second-arm test had incomplete mock and did not prove full global gate; selection now validates both completion records first and test distinguishes completed replay from missing overlay before any development rows are read.

checks.release: Candidate SHA bound; exact full review coverage; any nonaccept excludes entire source group; synthetic provenance retained; no claim of human review.
checks.matched_training: Both arms load same initial step-2976 adapter, create fresh AdamW with identical LR/seed/weight-decay/1530 steps/12235 sample positions; resume restores only its own state. Overlay covers all 12235 rows once; replay covers 11899 rows plus 336 repeated positions.
checks.selection: Original raw-base development gate retained; both complete arms required before six fixed checkpoint candidates compared; immutable single global winner; initial adapter history is not a new candidate; calibration/final only via global accepted winner.
checks.freeze: Parent source/config/checkpoint/model and current data/dependencies/packages are validated and frozen; changed code review or release hashes stop subsequent execution.
checks.concurrency: Sequential arm execution and shared financial-eight-actions-gpu.lock; live PID plus creation time/command/cwd detection; hidden launch window.
checks.pause_resume: Shared control across arms; checkpoint files and optimizer/RNG state are persisted before safe pause; main process exit required before safe_to_shutdown; resume explicit; invalid full checkpoints rejected.
checks.non_goals: No Jev requests, no default service switch, no deployment, no modification of old frozen source/data.

tests.execution: CPU; outside sandbox because Windows restricted tempfile directories caused permission errors in both old and new tests

tests.name: PowerShell Language.Parser parse all three boundary scripts
Independent CPU fake-checkpoint corruption/missing-file rejection and actual Windows OS lock conflict
tests.detail: A complete CPU fixture validates; tampered adapter and missing training-state both reject; nested exclusive lock rejects. No actual model checkpoints changed.

limitations: Code/CPU review does not demonstrate real GPU resume numerical equivalence; root must confirm live training initialization and safe pause/resume smoke separately.
Dataset remains synthetic, with developer-informed categories; independent AI review does not make it human-authored or eliminate adaptive-development bias.
Historical/raw timing and new-arm timing occur at different thermal/load states; comparisons are descriptive.
This review approves the bound execution code for the authorized experiment, not model deployment or accuracy acceptance.
